record_title: Gaussian-boundary hypergeometric laws: sharp Hellinger rate and root-n noncontiguity
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The sharp Hellinger result treats the standardized one-parameter beta-precision hypergeometric path. Plug-in location/scale, the full critical likelihood-ratio experiment, second-order Hellinger terms, and finite-sample errors are not derived. General sparse-mixture, heavy-impurity, and normal-scale-mixture theory remains a residual originality risk; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
